Luxury, sophisticated style (suitable for visitors, dates or special occasions)
Jul 2026 • Family
I had a wonderful evening at the restaurant. The first impression is a modern Chinese design space, warm, polite and very quiet, extremely suitable for visitors or VIP family meetings.
The “must-try” when you come here:
The Four Seasons: The beans are as soft as melting in the mouth, the fever compares.
The swine turns: Swine meat has a brittle layer of skin, the fat and lean parts of the mixture are not stained.
The cake: The powder layer is thin and soft, the sweet water squeezes up to eat very attractive.
The room has large round tables suitable for large families. The only downside is that the cold is sometimes a bit slow, but the delicious food should be completely sympathetic!
